out.note: Left on 13 May 1997 after the previous campaign.

overview: Liverpool finished third in the Premier League under Roy Evans, taking 65 points, 13 fewer than champions Arsenal. Michael Owen was the club’s leading scorer with 23 competitive goals. His 18 league goals earned a share of the Premier League Golden Boot with Dion Dublin and Chris Sutton.

Paul Ince arrived from Internazionale, Karl-Heinz Riedle from Borussia Dortmund and Øyvind Leonhardsen from Wimbledon. Danny Murphy also joined from Crewe Alexandra. Stan Collymore moved to Aston Villa after the previous campaign, and John Barnes left for Newcastle United in August.

Liverpool reached the League Cup semi-final but lost 3–2 on aggregate to Middlesbrough. Coventry City ended their FA Cup run in the third round with a 3–1 win at Anfield, while Strasbourg won their UEFA Cup second-round tie 3–2 on aggregate. Liverpool’s final two home league matches brought a 5–0 win over West Ham and a 4–0 victory over Arsenal.
